fixed_paragraph: When faced with a new idea, I prefer to stick with what I know. When someone suggests trying a new restaurant, I choose my usual spot. When a friend recommends a book outside my favorite genre, I politely decline. When planning a vacation, I return to familiar destinations. When a colleague proposes a different approach at work, I rely on proven methods. When decorating my home, I keep the same style I've always had. When listening to music, I play my favorite songs on repeat. When shopping for clothes, I buy the same styles I always wear. When cooking, I follow recipes I've mastered.
